assignments.reason: The fire of the angel is the manifestation of heart-fervor as destructive holy fire. Section ב: 'וְאֵשׁ הַמַּלְאָךְ הַזֶּה נַעֲשֶׂה מִבְּחִינַת מִשְׁפָּט' — while it is *produced* by mishpat (Package 1), its essential nature IS angelic fire, the same fire-fervor-angels domain that defines Package 2. The text in section א already established: 'שֶׁיַּזְמִין מַלְאֲכֵי לִבּוֹ... וְאֵשׁ הַזֶּה הוּא שׂוֹרֵף אוֹתָם' — this fire IS the angels of the heart. It burns the klipot, receives the power of the flame, and is the operational expression of the heart-fervor. Its nature is fire/angels, not judgment.

Self-judgment is the active form of mishpat (already in Package 1). Section ב: 'שֶׁמְּכַלְכֵּל דְּבָרָיו בְּמִשְׁפָּט, שֶׁאָדָם שׁוֹפֵט אֶת עַצְמוֹ' — the text defines self-judgment as the substance of mishpat. And mishpat = ריבועא = the square pole of the circle-and-square structure. The essential nature of this concept is judgment/mishpat, which is the core of Package 1's square dimension.

Building the Holy Temple is the construction of the כבוד/כסא כבוד structure. Section א: 'הַכָּבוֹד זֶהוּ בְּחִינַת הֵיכָל, בִּבְחִינַת וּבְהֵיכָלוֹ כֻּלּוֹ אוֹמֵר כָּבוֹד' — the Temple IS the kavod, and kavod is assigned to Package 1 via additions (כבוד ↔ כסא כבוד). The Holy Temple is the structure of divine honor centered on the Throne of Glory — the circle-and-square architecture. Its essential nature is the Throne/Temple/kavod domain.

assignments.node_id: כסא ומשפט הנ"ל, כי על־ידי שמכלכל דבריו במשפט
assignments.reason: This composite node names the throne-and-judgment structure directly — כסא כבוד and משפט are both core nodes of Package 1. The text in section ה: 'וְכָל זֶה נַעֲשֶׂה עַל־יְדֵי כִּסֵּא וּמִשְׁפָּט הַנַּ"ל' — this is the unified עיגולא-וריבועא as an active principle. Its essential nature is the circle-square-throne domain.

assignments.node_id: יכול ללמד לתלמידים חכמתו, ולא יזיק להם.
assignments.reason: The ability to teach students without harm is the practical expression of the יד (hand) concept. Section ה: 'יָד, הַיְנוּ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לוֹ כֹּחַ לְהַעֲמִיד תַּלְמִידִים הֲגוּנִים, וּלְהַמְשִׁיךְ בָּהֶם רוּחַ חָכְמָה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב: וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן מָלֵא רוּחַ חָכְמָה כִּי סָמַךְ מֹשֶׁה יָדָיו עָלָיו' — the power to transmit wisdom IS the יד, and יד = ריבועא = משפט, all in Package 1. The edge (1330) also connects it directly to כסא ומשפט as its cause. Its essential nature is the hand/square/judgment power that enables safe transmission.

assignments.node_id: כששומר את עצמו מכעס ומגדיל החומה של עשירות, ובזה מגדיל נפשו ושמו
assignments.reason: This node describes the combined action of guarding from anger and building the wealth-wall, which are the defining concepts of Package 3. Section ה: 'כְּשֶׁשּׁוֹמֵר אֶת עַצְמוֹ מִכַּעַס וּמַגְדִּיל הַחוֹמָה שֶׁל עֲשִׁירוּת' — it explicitly names חומה, כעס, and עשירות, the three pillars of Package 3. Its essential nature is the wall-anger-wealth triad.

All souls desiring to be included in the tzaddik's soul is the outcome of the נפש/שם growing through the wealth-wall. Section ה: 'כָּל הַנְּפָשׁוֹת שָׁרְשָׁם בַּעֲשִׁירוּת... בִּשְׁבִיל זֶה הַכֹּל תְּאֵבִים לְקָרֵב אֶת עַצְמוֹ לְעָשִׁיר, כִּי שָׁם שֹׁרֶשׁ נַפְשָׁם' — the text roots this soul-inclusion in עשירות (wealth). Since נפש is assigned to Package 3 via additions (שם ↔ נפש, with נפש rooted in wealth), and עשירות/ממון are in Package 3, this concept's essential nature is the soul-wealth nexus.

assignments.node_id: שיזכה לשם טוב, שכל הנפשות יתאוו תאוה להיות נשרשים בשמו
assignments.reason: Meriting a good name with all souls rooted in it is the ultimate outcome of the חומה domain. Section ה: 'וְלַשֵּׁם הַזֶּה יִזְכּוּ, מֵחֲמַת בְּחִינַת חוֹמָה' — the text explicitly attributes this name-merit to the חומה. Since שם bridges Packages 1 and 3, and נפש is in Package 3, the combined שם-נפש outcome belongs in Package 3 because it arises from the wall/wealth/anger-suppression complex.

Suppressing one's anger is functionally identical to כבישת כעס, already in Package 3. Section ה: 'בְּחִינַת מַאֲרִיךְ אַף, שֶׁיִּכְבֹּשׁ כַּעֲסוֹ' — this is the same anger-suppression concept expressed in verbal form. Its essential nature is the restraint/wall domain.

Guarding oneself from anger is the protective form of כבישת כעס. Section ה: 'וְעִקַּר שְׁמִירַת הַשֵּׁם, שְׁמִירַת הַנֶּפֶשׁ, אֵינוֹ אֶלָּא שֶׁיִּשְׁמֹר מִכַּעַס' — guarding from anger is the essential protection of the name/soul. Its nature is anger-suppression, the same domain as כבישת כעס and חומה in Package 3.

Guarding the Name and guarding the soul are the שם/נפש dimension of the חומה complex. Section ה: 'וְעִקַּר שְׁמִירַת הַשֵּׁם, שְׁמִירַת הַנֶּפֶשׁ, אֵינוֹ אֶלָּא שֶׁיִּשְׁמֹר מִכַּעַס' — the text defines name-guarding and soul-guarding as dependent on anger-suppression, which is the core of Package 3. Since נפש is assigned to Package 3 via additions, and the wall protects the name-soul, this concept's essential nature is the protective wall domain.

unassigned_nodes.reason: This node represents the tzaddik/teacher who draws people close to God — the subject/agent of the entire Torah. He is not a structural bechina concept but the person performing the actions described. He does not share the essential nature of any existing package (he is not the circle-square structure, not heart-fervor, not the wall-wealth complex). He is the one who activates all three domains. The additions analysis also noted: 'He is the agent, not a bechina-concept. Not a package member.' No other unassigned nodes cluster with him to form a new package.

unassigned_nodes.node_id: מחמת  שהיכל הנ"ל נעשה מהנפשות אשר היו רחוקים עד הנה, ויש קלפות רבות השוכנים סביבם, בבחינת (יחזקאל ה): "זאת ירושלים שמתיה בתוך הגוים". ואפשר עכשו כשמלביש ההיכל את הלב כנ"ל, אפשר שיתאחזו, חס ושלום, החיצונים, ביצר מחשבות לבו של הכשר הזה
unassigned_nodes.reason: This is a sentence-length problem description, not a discrete concept: the danger that klipot may cling to the tzaddik's heart when the Temple (built from formerly-distant souls) clothes his heart. It describes a situation/threat rather than a thematic concept. It does not share the essential nature of any existing package — the klipot/chitzonim are an evil force, but there is no evil package in this Torah (all three packages are good-polarity). As a single node it cannot form a new package on its own. It is the negative circumstance that motivates the eitza (Package 2's heart-fervor solution).
